title: Properties of human centrin 2 and cooperative effects between the N- and C-terminal domains
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38201-38210
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04219D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jing Yang, Yaqin Zhao, Binsheng Yang
There is a cooperative effect between the N-terminal and C-terminal domains of HsCen2. As evidenced by differences in Tb3+/DNA binding, aggregation, and endonuclease-like activity between the full-length protein and its isolated domains.
